proposed_graph.baseline: Independent original M95 middle LN/FFN path, original fine/coarse/rawbanks/FPS/CSORT/HCG and single inst update retained. Original cf outer skip remains.
proposed_graph.ordering: Per original coarse parent, actual true-point-supported middle IDs sorted by detached centroid x/y/z then originalID.
proposed_graph.states: Maintain n original-ID-associated C-dimensional states throughout; no synthetic token padding to next power2. Maintaining nC storage does not imply injectivity, invertibility or lossless evidence.
proposed_graph.stages: m=ceil(log2 n), fixed bits ascending0..m-1 then descending m-2..0. Each stage pairs i<j<n with j=i xor2**bit; disjoint pairs synchronously consume old-stage states. Shared Linear2C→2C then originalGELU gives two newC states. Unpaired rows keep original stage state.
proposed_graph.singletons: Same shared pair module on [x,0], retain firstC output; no extra singleton-only module. n0/unsupported/internalempty/batchpadding delta0, rawcf preserved by originalskip.

nearest_graph_differences.BTC: BTC compresses at tree internal nodes into C inside summaries and computes outside/complement C. Proposed graph keeps a C state per leaf and replaces both paired leaf states at each logarithmic-stage sweep; no internal parent-C node or outside readback.
nearest_graph_differences.BCR: BCR has strict-exclusive prefix/suffix chains with own only at final linear readout; proposed own and other information are jointly transformed at each pair stage. It is self-inclusive, not an exclusive-complement claim.
nearest_graph_differences.PSBR: PSBR is inclusive bidirectional sequential recurrence of C accumulated states then readout and removed baseline middle skip. Proposed fixed disjoint pair stages preserve originalskip and do not use forward/backward recurrent accumulator for each target. Activation/skip alone are not claimed contribution.
nearest_graph_differences.PSNC: PSNC applies a single fixed-basis transform/nonlinearity/inverse, while proposed multiple pair stages have intervening nonlinearities. Not claiming these are generally algebraically interchangeable.
nearest_graph_differences.HRC_HAP_MDC: No repeated bottom-up refined-mean composition, affine coarse-to-fine prolongation, or local directional depthwise convolution; source integration must confirm.
nearest_graph_differences.held_routes: No old held/rejected ID or revision is resumed/reopened. New model graph does not relax PCE/RSTR/family holds; generic shared-parent support is not alone a whole-computation equivalence proof.
